rows.note: main compares two session files and asserts exit 1, schema_version, identical, counts.added, both event counts, and that every delta category is one of the six names. validate judges one document. A synthetic object does not run that CLI sweep.

diff_sessions and to_dict build one document, then load_diff_schema checks the const, every required key, every side required key, and category membership for each delta. validate does not load sessions or open a schema path. One accepted object is not that multi-assert sweep.
